title: Tyler Chou (creators' attorney) applies Incorruptible to creators — 'Success is what attracts predators'
summary: Tyler Chou — 'the creators' attorney' — meets with Jenny Hoyos (MrBeast Shorts consultant; directed MrBeast's second most-watched TikTok of all time) as she plans her own business. Applies Incorruptible to the creator economy: a following is not an asset, the guardrails have to exist before the money arrives, and most creators write their operating agreement the week a buyer shows up — which is the week it stops being theirs to write.
blockquote: Eric Ries has a new book out called Incorruptible. One idea stuck with me. The guardrails have to exist before the money arrives. Success is what attracts predators.
attribution_title: The Creators' Attorney (Jenny Hoyos / MrBeast Shorts)
